# machine-ui: full reference

> A theming-first design system on shadcn/ui and Radix. Components install as source through the shadcn CLI. A theme engine generates colour, type, spacing, corners and motion from a few personality settings, and solves every colour pair for WCAG 2.2 contrast in light and dark.

## Rules

- Build interfaces from these components; do not hand-roll equivalents.
- Style with semantic tokens only (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `var(--primary)`): no raw colours, px values, gradients or font names.
- Pair every surface with its `-foreground` token; use `text-link` for coloured text. These pairs are contrast-solved.
- Use the spacing scale and `h-(--control-sm|md|lg)` for control heights, `rounded-sm|md|lg|xl` for corners.
- Keep keyboard access, visible focus and labels: icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
- JavaScript-driven motion (charts, streaming text) must respect `useReducedMotion()`.

## Accordion

A stack of headings that each reveal a section. One or several sections can be open.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/accordion`

Example:

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'accordion',
  name: 'Accordion',
  category: 'layout',
  description: 'A stack of headings that each reveal a section. One or several sections can be open.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'FAQ',
      render: () => (
        <Accordion type="single" collapsible defaultValue="contrast" className="w-full max-w-md">
          <AccordionItem value="contrast">
            <AccordionTrigger>How is contrast guaranteed?</AccordionTrigger>
            <AccordionContent>
              The engine adjusts lightness until every text pair reaches 4.5:1 and every control boundary 3:1, in light and dark.
            </AccordionContent>
          </AccordionItem>
          <AccordionItem value="fonts">
            <AccordionTrigger>Can I use my own fonts?</AccordionTrigger>
            <AccordionContent>Yes. Set the typeface tokens after applying a theme, or add a pairing to the token package.</AccordionContent>
          </AccordionItem>
          <AccordionItem value="shadcn">
            <AccordionTrigger>Does it work with existing shadcn/ui code?</AccordionTrigger>
            <AccordionContent>Colour variables use shadcn’s names, so existing components pick up the theme unchanged.</AccordionContent>
          </AccordionItem>
        </Accordion>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Agent Glyph

The agent’s mark, used as its avatar beside messages and activity. Takes the theme’s primary colour.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/agent-glyph`

### AgentGlyph

- `label?`: string

Example:

```tsx
import { AgentGlyph } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'agent-glyph',
  name: 'Agent Glyph',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'The agent’s mark, used as its avatar beside messages and activity. Takes the theme’s primary colour.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Sizes',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <AgentGlyph className="size-6" />
          <AgentGlyph />
          <AgentGlyph className="size-12" label="Alpha, your assistant" />
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Alert

An inline banner with a title and a description, in default, success, warning and destructive variants.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/alert`

### Alert

- `variant?`: "default" | "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Info, TriangleAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'alert',
  name: 'Alert',
  category: 'feedback',
  description: 'An inline banner with a title and a description, in default, success, warning and destructive variants.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Variants',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-lg gap-3">
          <Alert>
            <Info aria-hidden />
            <AlertTitle>New version available</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>Reload to get the latest components.</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
          <Alert variant="success">
            <CircleCheck aria-hidden />
            <AlertTitle>Theme published</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>Everyone with the link now sees the new colours.</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
          <Alert variant="warning">
            <TriangleAlert aria-hidden />
            <AlertTitle>Usage at 90%</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>You have 2,000 requests left this month.</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <CircleAlert aria-hidden />
            <AlertTitle>Deploy failed</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>The build stopped at step 3. Check the logs and retry.</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Alert Dialog

A modal that interrupts to confirm a consequential action. It only closes through its buttons or Escape.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/alert-dialog @machine-ui/button`

### AlertDialogAction

- `variant?`: "default" | "destructive"

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
  Button,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'alert-dialog',
  name: 'Alert Dialog',
  category: 'overlays',
  description: 'A modal that interrupts to confirm a consequential action. It only closes through its buttons or Escape.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Destructive',
      render: () => (
        <AlertDialog>
          <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button variant="destructive">Delete workspace</Button>
          </AlertDialogTrigger>
          <AlertDialogContent>
            <AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Northwind?</AlertDialogTitle>
              <AlertDialogDescription>
                This removes 14 projects, their themes and history for every member. It can’t be undone.
              </AlertDialogDescription>
            </AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogFooter>
              <AlertDialogCancel>Keep workspace</AlertDialogCancel>
              <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Delete workspace</AlertDialogAction>
            </AlertDialogFooter>
          </AlertDialogContent>
        </AlertDialog>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Approval Card

The agent asks before it acts: a question, a few options and Confirm or Skip.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/approval-card`

### ApprovalCard

- `defaultValue?`: string | (readonly string[] & string)
- `onConfirm?`: ((value: string) => void)
- `onSkip?`: (() => void)
- `options`: ApprovalOption[]
- `question`: string

Example:

```tsx
import { ApprovalCard } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'approval-card',
  name: 'Approval Card',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'The agent asks before it acts: a question, a few options and Confirm or Skip.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <ApprovalCard
          className="max-w-md"
          question="How should I reply to Acme?"
          options={[
            { value: 'workaround', label: 'Send the workaround', description: 'Restores sync now; fix lands Thursday.' },
            { value: 'wait', label: 'Wait for the fix', description: 'Reply Thursday with the release note.' },
            { value: 'escalate', label: 'Escalate to engineering' },
          ]}
        />
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Aspect Ratio

Keeps media at a fixed shape as its width changes.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/aspect-ratio`

Example:

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'aspect-ratio',
  name: 'Aspect Ratio',
  category: 'layout',
  description: 'Keeps media at a fixed shape as its width changes.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: '16 by 9',
      render: () => (
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <AspectRatio ratio={16 / 9} className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            16 : 9
          </AspectRatio>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Avatar

Shows a person as a photo or initials, alone or as an overlapping group.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/avatar`

Example:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarImage } from '@machine-ui/ui';

/** An abstract portrait as an inline SVG, so the example needs no network. */
const PORTRAIT =
  "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 40 40'><rect width='40' height='40' opacity='0.12'/><circle cx='20' cy='16' r='7' opacity='0.45'/><rect x='8' y='26' width='24' height='14' rx='7' opacity='0.45'/></svg>";
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'avatar',
  name: 'Avatar',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'Shows a person as a photo or initials, alone or as an overlapping group.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Photo and fallback',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Avatar className="size-10">
            <AvatarImage src={PORTRAIT} alt="Ada Lovelace" />
            <AvatarFallback>AL</AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
          <Avatar className="size-10">
            <AvatarImage src="/missing-photo.png" alt="Grace Hopper" />
            <AvatarFallback>GH</AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Group',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
          <Avatar className="size-10">
            <AvatarFallback>AL</AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
          <AvatarGroup>
            {['GH', 'KJ', 'MH', 'RB'].map((initials) => (
              <Avatar key={initials}>
                <AvatarFallback>{initials}</AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
            ))}
          </AvatarGroup>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Badge

A small label for state or category, in primary, secondary, outline and destructive styles.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/badge`

### Badge

- `variant?`: "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'badge',
  name: 'Badge',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'A small label for state or category, in primary, secondary, outline and destructive styles.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Variants',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Badge>Live</Badge>
          <Badge variant="secondary">Draft</Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline">v2.4.0</Badge>
          <Badge variant="destructive">3 failing</Badge>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Breadcrumb

Shows where a page sits in the hierarchy, with a collapsed middle for long trails.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/breadcrumb`

### BreadcrumbLink

- `asChild?`: boolean

Example:

```tsx
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbEllipsis,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'breadcrumb',
  name: 'Breadcrumb',
  category: 'navigation',
  description: 'Shows where a page sits in the hierarchy, with a collapsed middle for long trails.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <Breadcrumb>
          <BreadcrumbList>
            <BreadcrumbItem>
              <BreadcrumbLink href="#home">Home</BreadcrumbLink>
            </BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbSeparator />
            <BreadcrumbItem>
              <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
            </BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbSeparator />
            <BreadcrumbItem>
              <BreadcrumbLink href="#components">Components</BreadcrumbLink>
            </BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbSeparator />
            <BreadcrumbItem>
              <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
            </BreadcrumbItem>
          </BreadcrumbList>
        </Breadcrumb>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Button

Triggers an action. Six variants and four sizes, with icon, loading and disabled states.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { ArrowRight, Loader2, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'button',
  name: 'Button',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'Triggers an action. Six variants and four sizes, with icon, loading and disabled states.',
  examples: [
    { name: 'Default', render: () => <Button>Send reply</Button> },
    {
      name: 'Variants',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Button>Primary</Button>
          <Button variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
          <Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
          <Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
          <Button variant="link">Read the docs</Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Sizes',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Button size="sm">Small</Button>
          <Button>Medium</Button>
          <Button size="lg">Large</Button>
          <Button size="icon" aria-label="Add">
            <Plus aria-hidden />
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'With icon',
      render: () => (
        <Button>
          Continue <ArrowRight aria-hidden />
        </Button>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Loading',
      render: () => (
        <Button disabled>
          <Loader2 aria-hidden className="animate-spin" /> Saving
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Button Group

Joins related buttons into one row with shared edges, including split buttons.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/button-group`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### ButtonGroup

- `orientation?`: "horizontal" | "vertical"

Example:

```tsx
import { Button, ButtonGroup } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'button-group',
  name: 'Button Group',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'Joins related buttons into one row with shared edges, including split buttons.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <ButtonGroup aria-label="Message actions">
          <Button variant="outline">Reply</Button>
          <Button variant="outline">Assign</Button>
          <Button variant="outline">Snooze</Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Split button',
      render: () => (
        <ButtonGroup aria-label="Deploy">
          <Button>Deploy</Button>
          <Button size="icon" aria-label="More deploy options" className="border-l border-primary-foreground/20">
            <ChevronDown aria-hidden />
          </Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Calendar

A month grid for picking a single date or a range, with today marked and keyboard navigation.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/calendar`

Example:

```tsx
import { Calendar } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const MONTH = new Date(2026, 9, 1);

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'calendar',
  name: 'Calendar',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'A month grid for picking a single date or a range, with today marked and keyboard navigation.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Single date',
      render: () => <Calendar mode="single" defaultMonth={MONTH} selected={new Date(2026, 9, 19)} className="rounded-md border" />,
    },
    {
      name: 'Range',
      render: () => (
        <Calendar
          mode="range"
          defaultMonth={MONTH}
          selected={{ from: new Date(2026, 9, 12), to: new Date(2026, 9, 16) }}
          className="rounded-md border"
        />
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Card

Groups related content on a raised surface. Whether it uses a border or a shadow comes from the theme’s separation setting.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/card`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'card',
  name: 'Card',
  category: 'data',
  description:
    'Groups related content on a raised surface. Whether it uses a border or a shadow comes from the theme’s separation setting.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Quarterly report</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Revenue and retention for Q3.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="text-sm">Net revenue grew 12% while churn held at 2.1%.</CardContent>
          <CardFooter className="gap-2">
            <Button size="sm">Open report</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
              Share
            </Button>
          </CardFooter>
        </Card>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Carousel

A row of slides with previous and next buttons, swipe, and arrow-key support.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/card @machine-ui/carousel`

### Carousel

- `opts?`: Partial<OptionsType>
- `orientation?`: "horizontal" | "vertical"

### CarouselNext

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### CarouselPrevious

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Card, CardContent, Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const SLIDES = ['Graphite', 'Harbor', 'Folio', 'Console', 'Bloom'];

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'carousel',
  name: 'Carousel',
  category: 'layout',
  description: 'A row of slides with previous and next buttons, swipe, and arrow-key support.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <Carousel className="w-full max-w-xs" aria-label="Themes">
          <CarouselContent>
            {SLIDES.map((name, i) => (
              <CarouselItem key={name} aria-label={`${i + 1} of ${SLIDES.length}`}>
                <Card>
                  <CardContent className="flex aspect-square items-center justify-center p-6">
                    <span className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold">{name}</span>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </CarouselItem>
            ))}
          </CarouselContent>
          <CarouselPrevious />
          <CarouselNext />
        </Carousel>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Chart

Recharts with theme colours, gridlines and tooltips. Series colours come from the chart tokens.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/chart @machine-ui/use-reduced-motion`

### ChartContainer

- `config`: ChartConfig

### ChartLegendContent

- `payload?`: { dataKey?: string | number; value?: string; color?: string; }[]

### ChartTooltipContent

- `active?`: boolean
- `hideLabel?`: boolean
- `label?`: ReactNode
- `payload?`: TooltipPayloadItem[]

Example:

```tsx
import { ChartContainer, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, Recharts, useReducedMotion, type ChartConfig } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const DATA = [
  { month: 'May', visitors: 1860, signups: 420 },
  { month: 'Jun', visitors: 3050, signups: 610 },
  { month: 'Jul', visitors: 2370, signups: 530 },
  { month: 'Aug', visitors: 2730, signups: 690 },
  { month: 'Sep', visitors: 3490, signups: 880 },
  { month: 'Oct', visitors: 4120, signups: 1020 },
];

const config = {
  visitors: { label: 'Visitors', color: 'var(--chart-1)' },
  signups: { label: 'Sign-ups', color: 'var(--chart-2)' },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

// Chart animations run in JavaScript, so they follow the reduced-motion preference explicitly.
function BarExample() {
  const animate = !useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <ChartContainer config={config} className="h-64 w-full max-w-2xl" role="img" aria-label="Visitors and sign-ups by month, May to October">
      <Recharts.BarChart data={DATA} accessibilityLayer>
        <Recharts.CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
        <Recharts.XAxis dataKey="month" tickLine={false} axisLine={false} tickMargin={8} interval={0} minTickGap={0} />
        <ChartTooltip cursor={false} content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
        <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent />} />
        <Recharts.Bar isAnimationActive={animate} dataKey="visitors" fill="var(--color-visitors)" radius={4} />
        <Recharts.Bar isAnimationActive={animate} dataKey="signups" fill="var(--color-signups)" radius={4} />
      </Recharts.BarChart>
    </ChartContainer>
  );
}

function AreaExample() {
  const animate = !useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <ChartContainer config={config} className="h-64 w-full max-w-2xl" role="img" aria-label="Visitors by month, rising from 1,860 to 4,120">
      <Recharts.AreaChart data={DATA} margin={{ left: 12, right: 12 }}>
        <Recharts.CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
        <Recharts.XAxis dataKey="month" tickLine={false} axisLine={false} tickMargin={8} interval={0} minTickGap={0} />
        <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
        <Recharts.Area isAnimationActive={animate} dataKey="visitors" type="monotone" fill="var(--color-visitors)" fillOpacity={0.15} stroke="var(--color-visitors)" strokeWidth={2} />
      </Recharts.AreaChart>
    </ChartContainer>
  );
}

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'chart',
  name: 'Chart',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'Recharts with theme colours, gridlines and tooltips. Series colours come from the chart tokens.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Bar',
      wide: true,
      render: () => <BarExample />,
    },
    {
      name: 'Area',
      wide: true,
      render: () => <AreaExample />,
    },
  ],
});
```

## Checkbox

Turns an option on or off. Supports an indeterminate state for "some selected".

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/checkbox @machine-ui/label`

Example:

```tsx
import { Checkbox, Label } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'checkbox',
  name: 'Checkbox',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'Turns an option on or off. Supports an indeterminate state for "some selected".',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'States',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Checkbox id="cb-1" />
            <Label htmlFor="cb-1">Email me about new releases</Label>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Checkbox id="cb-2" defaultChecked />
            <Label htmlFor="cb-2">Share anonymous usage data</Label>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Checkbox id="cb-3" checked="indeterminate" />
            <Label htmlFor="cb-3">Some teams selected</Label>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Checkbox id="cb-4" disabled />
            <Label htmlFor="cb-4">Requires admin</Label>
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

```tsx
            <CommandGroup heading="Suggestions">
              <CommandItem>
                <Palette aria-hidden /> Change theme
              </CommandItem>
              <CommandItem>
                <FileText aria-hidden /> New document
              </CommandItem>
            </CommandGroup>
            <CommandSeparator />
            <CommandGroup heading="Settings">
              <CommandItem>
                <User aria-hidden /> Profile <CommandShortcut>⌘P</CommandShortcut>
              </CommandItem>
              <CommandItem>
                <CreditCard aria-hidden /> Billing <CommandShortcut>⌘B</CommandShortcut>
              </CommandItem>
              <CommandItem>
                <Settings aria-hidden /> Preferences <CommandShortcut>⌘,</CommandShortcut>
              </CommandItem>
            </CommandGroup>
          </CommandList>
        </Command>
      ),
    },
  ],
```

## Command Palette

Command in a modal, opened from a button or a shortcut. Typing filters, arrows move, Enter runs, Escape closes.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/command @machine-ui/kbd`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### CommandDialog

- `description?`: string
- `title?`: string

Example:

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  CommandDialog,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
  CommandShortcut,
  Kbd,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { FileText, Palette, Settings } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

function Palette_() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open command palette <Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>
      </Button>
      <CommandDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <CommandInput placeholder="Type a command or search…" />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty>No results.</CommandEmpty>
          <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
            <CommandItem onSelect={() => setOpen(false)}>
              <Palette aria-hidden /> Change theme
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem onSelect={() => setOpen(false)}>
              <FileText aria-hidden /> New document
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem onSelect={() => setOpen(false)}>
              <Settings aria-hidden /> Preferences <CommandShortcut>⌘,</CommandShortcut>
            </CommandItem>
          </CommandGroup>
        </CommandList>
      </CommandDialog>
    </>
  );
}

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'command-palette',
  name: 'Command Palette',
  category: 'overlays',
  description: 'Command in a modal, opened from a button or a shortcut. Typing filters, arrows move, Enter runs, Escape closes.',
  examples: [{ name: 'Default', render: () => <Palette_ /> }],
});
```

## Data Table

A table with sorting, filtering, row selection and pagination, built on TanStack Table.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/badge @machine-ui/data-table`

### Badge

- `variant?`: "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | null

### DataTable

- `className?`: string
- `columns`: ColumnDef<TData>[]
- `data`: TData[]
- `filterColumn?`: string
- `filterPlaceholder?`: string
- `pageSize?`: number
- `toolbar?`: ReactNode

### DataTableColumnHeader

- `column`: Column<TData, unknown>
- `title`: string

Example:

```tsx
import { Badge, DataTable, DataTableColumnHeader, selectionColumn, type ColumnDef } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

interface Member {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'Owner' | 'Admin' | 'Member';
  lastActive: string;
}

const MEMBERS: Member[] = [
  { name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@northwind.dev', role: 'Owner', lastActive: 'Today' },
  { name: 'Grace Hopper', email: 'grace@northwind.dev', role: 'Admin', lastActive: 'Today' },
  { name: 'Katherine Johnson', email: 'kj@northwind.dev', role: 'Member', lastActive: 'Yesterday' },
  { name: 'Margaret Hamilton', email: 'margaret@northwind.dev', role: 'Admin', lastActive: '3 days ago' },
  { name: 'Radia Perlman', email: 'radia@northwind.dev', role: 'Member', lastActive: 'Last week' },
  { name: 'Barbara Liskov', email: 'barbara@northwind.dev', role: 'Member', lastActive: 'Today' },
  { name: 'Frances Allen', email: 'frances@northwind.dev', role: 'Member', lastActive: '2 days ago' },
];

const columns: ColumnDef<Member>[] = [
  selectionColumn<Member>(),
  { accessorKey: 'name', header: ({ column }) => <DataTableColumnHeader column={column} title="Name" /> },
  { accessorKey: 'email', header: 'Email', cell: ({ getValue }) => <span className="text-muted-foreground">{getValue<string>()}</span> },
  {
    accessorKey: 'role',
    header: ({ column }) => <DataTableColumnHeader column={column} title="Role" />,
    cell: ({ getValue }) => <Badge variant={getValue() === 'Owner' ? 'default' : 'outline'}>{getValue<string>()}</Badge>,
  },
  { accessorKey: 'lastActive', header: 'Last active' },
];

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'data-table',
  name: 'Data Table',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'A table with sorting, filtering, row selection and pagination, built on TanStack Table.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Members',
      wide: true,
      render: () => <DataTable className="max-w-3xl" columns={columns} data={MEMBERS} filterColumn="name" filterPlaceholder="Filter by name…" pageSize={5} />,
    },
  ],
});
```

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/field @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/switch`

### Field

- `orientation?`: "horizontal" | "vertical"

Example:

```tsx
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, Input, Switch } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'field',
  name: 'Field',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'Lays out a label, control, help text and error for one form field, so every form reads the same way.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Form',
      render: () => (
        <FieldSet className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <FieldLegend>Billing contact</FieldLegend>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="field-name">Full name</FieldLabel>
              <Input id="field-name" defaultValue="Ada Lovelace" />
            </Field>
            <Field data-invalid>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="field-email">Email</FieldLabel>
              <Input id="field-email" aria-invalid defaultValue="ada@" aria-describedby="field-email-error" />
              <FieldError id="field-email-error">Enter an email like ada@example.com.</FieldError>
            </Field>
            <Field orientation="horizontal">
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="field-receipts">Email receipts</FieldLabel>
              <Switch id="field-receipts" defaultChecked />
            </Field>
            <FieldDescription>Receipts go to the billing contact, not the account owner.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldGroup>
        </FieldSet>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Hover Card

A floating preview shown while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, its trigger.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/avatar @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/hover-card`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, Button, HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'hover-card',
  name: 'Hover Card',
  category: 'overlays',
  description: 'A floating preview shown while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, its trigger.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Profile preview',
      render: () => (
        <HoverCard openDelay={150}>
          <HoverCardTrigger asChild>
            <Button variant="link">@ada</Button>
          </HoverCardTrigger>
          <HoverCardContent>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <Avatar>
                <AvatarFallback>AL</AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
              <div className="grid gap-1 text-sm">
                <p className="font-medium">Ada Lovelace</p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">Design systems at Northwind. Maintains the theme engine.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </HoverCardContent>
        </HoverCard>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Input

A single-line text field, with invalid and disabled states.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label`

Example:

```tsx
import { Input, Label } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'input',
  name: 'Input',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'A single-line text field, with invalid and disabled states.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-xs gap-2">
          <Label htmlFor="input-name">Workspace name</Label>
          <Input id="input-name" defaultValue="Northwind" />
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Invalid',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-xs gap-2">
          <Label htmlFor="input-domain">Domain</Label>
          <Input id="input-domain" aria-invalid defaultValue="northwind" aria-describedby="input-domain-error" />
          <p id="input-domain-error" className="text-sm text-destructive">
            Enter a full domain, like northwind.com.
          </p>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Disabled',
      render: () => <Input aria-label="Team ID" disabled defaultValue="team_8f2k" className="max-w-xs" />,
    },
  ],
});
```

## Input Group

A text field with a fixed prefix, suffix or icon inside one border.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/input-group @machine-ui/label`

### InputGroupAddon

- `align?`: "start" | "end"

### InputGroupButton

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput, InputGroupText, Label } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { AtSign } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'input-group',
  name: 'Input Group',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'A text field with a fixed prefix, suffix or icon inside one border.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Prefix and suffix',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-4">
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="ig-site">Website</Label>
            <InputGroup>
              <InputGroupAddon>
                <InputGroupText>https://</InputGroupText>
              </InputGroupAddon>
              <InputGroupInput id="ig-site" placeholder="northwind" className="pl-1" />
              <InputGroupAddon align="end">
                <InputGroupText>.com</InputGroupText>
              </InputGroupAddon>
            </InputGroup>
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="ig-handle">Handle</Label>
            <InputGroup>
              <InputGroupAddon>
                <AtSign aria-hidden />
              </InputGroupAddon>
              <InputGroupInput id="ig-handle" placeholder="ada" />
            </InputGroup>
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="ig-invite">Invite by email</Label>
            <InputGroup>
              <InputGroupInput id="ig-invite" type="email" placeholder="grace@northwind.dev" />
              <InputGroupAddon align="end">
                <InputGroupButton variant="secondary">Send invite</InputGroupButton>
              </InputGroupAddon>
            </InputGroup>
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Input OTP

```tsx
              <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
            </InputOTPGroup>
            <InputOTPSeparator />
            <InputOTPGroup>
              <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={5} />

          </InputOTP>
```

## Item

A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists, settings and search results.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/item @machine-ui/switch`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### Item

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | null
- `variant?`: "default" | "outline" | "muted" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Button, Item, ItemActions, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, Switch } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { Bell, Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'item',
  name: 'Item',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists, settings and search results.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Settings list',
      render: () => (
        <ItemGroup className="w-full max-w-md gap-2">
          <Item variant="outline">
            <ItemMedia>
              <Shield aria-hidden />
            </ItemMedia>
            <ItemContent>
              <ItemTitle>Two-step verification</ItemTitle>
              <ItemDescription>Required for admins since 1 October.</ItemDescription>
            </ItemContent>
            <ItemActions>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                Manage
              </Button>
            </ItemActions>
          </Item>
          <Item variant="outline">
            <ItemMedia>
              <Bell aria-hidden />
            </ItemMedia>
            <ItemContent>
              <ItemTitle>Deploy notifications</ItemTitle>
              <ItemDescription>Email me when a deploy fails.</ItemDescription>
            </ItemContent>
            <ItemActions>
              <Switch aria-label="Deploy notifications" defaultChecked />
            </ItemActions>
          </Item>
        </ItemGroup>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Menubar

A row of menus like a desktop app bar. Open one, then arrow or hover across the others.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/menubar`

### MenubarItem

- `inset?`: boolean

Example:

```tsx
import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
  MenubarTrigger,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'menubar',
  name: 'Menubar',
  category: 'navigation',
  description: 'A row of menus like a desktop app bar. Open one, then arrow or hover across the others.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Editor',
      render: () => (
        <Menubar>
          <MenubarMenu>
            <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
            <MenubarContent>
              <MenubarGroup>
                <MenubarItem>
                  New file <MenubarShortcut>⌘N</MenubarShortcut>
                </MenubarItem>
                <MenubarItem>
                  Open… <MenubarShortcut>⌘O</MenubarShortcut>
                </MenubarItem>
              </MenubarGroup>
              <MenubarSeparator />
              <MenubarSub>
                <MenubarSubTrigger>Export</MenubarSubTrigger>
                <MenubarSubContent>
                  <MenubarItem>theme.css</MenubarItem>
                  <MenubarItem>tokens.json</MenubarItem>
                </MenubarSubContent>
              </MenubarSub>
            </MenubarContent>
          </MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarMenu>
            <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
            <MenubarContent>
              <MenubarItem>
                Undo <MenubarShortcut>⌘Z</MenubarShortcut>
              </MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem>
                Redo <MenubarShortcut>⇧⌘Z</MenubarShortcut>
              </MenubarItem>
            </MenubarContent>
          </MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarMenu>
            <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
            <MenubarContent>
              <MenubarCheckboxItem checked>Show grid</MenubarCheckboxItem>
              <MenubarCheckboxItem>Show rulers</MenubarCheckboxItem>
              <MenubarSeparator />
              <MenubarLabel>Zoom</MenubarLabel>
              <MenubarRadioGroup value="100">
                <MenubarRadioItem value="75">75%</MenubarRadioItem>
                <MenubarRadioItem value="100">100%</MenubarRadioItem>
                <MenubarRadioItem value="150">150%</MenubarRadioItem>
              </MenubarRadioGroup>
            </MenubarContent>
          </MenubarMenu>
        </Menubar>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Message

One turn in a conversation. User turns sit right in a bubble; assistant turns read as plain text with actions.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/agent-glyph @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/message`

### AgentGlyph

- `label?`: string

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### Message

- `from`: "user" | "assistant"

Example:

```tsx
import { AgentGlyph, Button, Message, MessageActions, MessageContent } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { Copy, RotateCcw, ThumbsDown, ThumbsUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'message',
  name: 'Message',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'One turn in a conversation. User turns sit right in a bubble; assistant turns read as plain text with actions.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Exchange',
      wide: true,
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-6">
          <Message from="user">
            <MessageContent>What happened with Acme’s outage, and what should I tell them?</MessageContent>
          </Message>
          <Message from="assistant">
            <AgentGlyph className="size-7" />
            <MessageContent>
              <p>
                The outage began after Tuesday’s deploy changed the sync interval. A fix ships Thursday. Until then, the workaround in
                the help centre restores sync within a minute.
              </p>
              <p>I’d send them the workaround now and promise an update Thursday.</p>
              <MessageActions>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-7" aria-label="Copy response">
                  <Copy aria-hidden />
                </Button>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-7" aria-label="Regenerate">
                  <RotateCcw aria-hidden />
                </Button>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-7" aria-label="Good response">
                  <ThumbsUp aria-hidden />
                </Button>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-7" aria-label="Bad response">
                  <ThumbsDown aria-hidden />
                </Button>
              </MessageActions>
            </MessageContent>
          </Message>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```


## Navigation Menu

Site navigation with dropdown panels of links, for marketing sites and docs.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/navigation-menu`

Example:

```tsx
import {
  NavigationMenu,
  NavigationMenuContent,
  NavigationMenuItem,
  NavigationMenuLink,
  NavigationMenuList,
  NavigationMenuTrigger,
  navigationMenuTriggerStyle,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const PRODUCTS = [
  ['Theme engine', 'Generate a contrast-safe theme from a few settings.'],
  ['Components', 'Sixty themed components on shadcn/ui and Radix.'],
  ['Agent kit', 'Skills that keep coding agents on-theme.'],
];

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'navigation-menu',
  name: 'Navigation Menu',
  category: 'navigation',
  description: 'Site navigation with dropdown panels of links, for marketing sites and docs.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <NavigationMenu>
          <NavigationMenuList>
            <NavigationMenuItem>
              <NavigationMenuTrigger>Product</NavigationMenuTrigger>
              <NavigationMenuContent>
                <ul className="grid w-80 gap-1">
                  {PRODUCTS.map(([title, body]) => (
                    <li key={title}>
                      <NavigationMenuLink href={`#${title}`}>
                        <span className="font-medium">{title}</span>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">{body}</span>
                      </NavigationMenuLink>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </NavigationMenuContent>
            </NavigationMenuItem>
            <NavigationMenuItem>
              <NavigationMenuLink href="#docs" className={navigationMenuTriggerStyle()}>
                Docs
              </NavigationMenuLink>
            </NavigationMenuItem>
            <NavigationMenuItem>
              <NavigationMenuLink href="#pricing" className={navigationMenuTriggerStyle()}>
                Pricing
              </NavigationMenuLink>
            </NavigationMenuItem>
          </NavigationMenuList>
        </NavigationMenu>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null

```tsx
              <PaginationLink href="#page-1">1</PaginationLink>
            </PaginationItem>
            <PaginationItem>
              <PaginationLink href="#page-2" isActive>
                2
              </PaginationLink>
            </PaginationItem>
            <PaginationItem>
              <PaginationLink href="#page-3">3</PaginationLink>
            </PaginationItem>
            <PaginationItem>
              <PaginationEllipsis />
            </PaginationItem>
```

## Prompt Input

The composer: auto-growing text, tools and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and it becomes a stop button while the agent works.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/prompt-input`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### PromptInput

- `busy?`: boolean
- `hint?`: ReactNode
- `label?`: string
- `onStop?`: (() => void)
- `onSubmit?`: ((value: string) => void)
- `placeholder?`: string
- `tools?`: ReactNode

### PromptSuggestions

- `onPick?`: ((suggestion: string) => void)
- `suggestions`: string[]

Example:

```tsx
import { Button, PromptInput, PromptSuggestions } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { Paperclip } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'prompt-input',
  name: 'Prompt Input',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'The composer: auto-growing text, tools and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and it becomes a stop button while the agent works.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'With suggestions',
      wide: true,
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-3">
          <PromptSuggestions suggestions={['What’s open with Acme?', 'Close tickets idle over 30 days', 'Summarise overnight tickets']} />
          <PromptInput
            placeholder="Ask Alpha about your inbox…"
            hint="Alpha can make mistakes. Check important replies before sending."
            tools={
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="text-muted-foreground">
                <Paperclip aria-hidden /> Attach
              </Button>
            }
          />
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Busy',
      wide: true,
      render: () => <PromptInput className="w-full max-w-xl" busy placeholder="Alpha is replying…" />,
    },
  ],
});
```

## Radio Group

A set of options where exactly one is selected. Arrow keys move the selection.

Example:

```tsx

  examples: [

      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <RadioGroup defaultValue="weekly" aria-label="Digest frequency">
          {[
            ['daily', 'Every morning'],
            ['weekly', 'Mondays only'],
            ['never', 'Never'],
          ].map(([value, label]) => (
            <div key={value} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <RadioGroupItem value={value!} id={`rg-${value}`} />
              <Label htmlFor={`rg-${value}`}>{label}</Label>

        </RadioGroup>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Scroll Area

A fixed-height container that scrolls its content with a thin, theme-coloured scrollbar.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/scroll-area @machine-ui/separator`

Example:

```tsx
import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar, Separator } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const RELEASES = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => `v2.${24 - i}.0`);

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'scroll-area',
  name: 'Scroll Area',
  category: 'layout',
  description: 'A fixed-height container that scrolls its content with a thin, theme-coloured scrollbar.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <ScrollArea className="h-56 w-48 rounded-md border" role="region" aria-label="Releases">
          <div className="p-4">
            <p className="mb-3 text-sm font-medium">Releases</p>
            {RELEASES.map((tag) => (
              <Fragment key={tag}>
                <div className="font-mono text-sm">{tag}</div>
                <Separator className="my-2" />
              </Fragment>
            ))}
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Horizontal',
      render: () => (
        <ScrollArea className="w-72 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border" role="region" aria-label="Recent themes">
          <div className="flex gap-3 p-4">
            {['graphite', 'harbor', 'folio', 'console', 'bloom', 'forge', 'custom-1', 'custom-2'].map((name) => (
              <div key={name} className="flex h-20 w-28 shrink-0 items-end rounded-md bg-muted p-2 text-sm">
                {name}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <ScrollBar orientation="horizontal" />
        </ScrollArea>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Sheet

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/input @machine-ui/label @machine-ui/sheet`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

### SheetContent

- `side?`: "right" | "left" | "top" | "bottom"

Example:

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Input,
  Label,
  Sheet,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'sheet',
  name: 'Sheet',
  category: 'overlays',
  description: 'A panel that slides in from any edge over a scrim. Good for edit forms and detail views.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Edit panel',
      render: () => (
        <Sheet>
          <SheetTrigger asChild>
            <Button variant="outline">Edit member</Button>
          </SheetTrigger>
          <SheetContent>
            <SheetHeader>
              <SheetTitle>Edit member</SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>Changes apply the next time they sign in.</SheetDescription>
            </SheetHeader>
            <div className="grid gap-4 px-4">
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label htmlFor="sheet-name">Name</Label>
                <Input id="sheet-name" defaultValue="Grace Hopper" />
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label htmlFor="sheet-role">Role</Label>
                <Input id="sheet-role" defaultValue="Admin" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <SheetFooter>
              <Button>Save member</Button>
              <SheetClose asChild>
                <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
              </SheetClose>
            </SheetFooter>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Sidebar

App navigation that collapses to icons on desktop and becomes a sheet on mobile. Ctrl/⌘+B toggles it.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/sidebar`

### Sidebar

- `collapsible?`: "none" | "icon" | "offcanvas"
- `side?`: "right" | "left"

### SidebarMenuButton

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `isActive?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null
- `tooltip?`: string

### SidebarProvider

- `defaultOpen?`: boolean
- `onOpenChange?`: ((open: boolean) => void)
- `open?`: boolean

### SidebarTrigger

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuBadge,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarSeparator,
  SidebarTrigger,
} from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { BarChart3, Home, Inbox, Settings, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const NAV = [
  { label: 'Home', icon: Home, active: true },
  { label: 'Inbox', icon: Inbox, badge: '12' },
  { label: 'Analytics', icon: BarChart3 },
  { label: 'Team', icon: Users },
];

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'sidebar',
  name: 'Sidebar',
  category: 'navigation',
  description: 'App navigation that collapses to icons on desktop and becomes a sheet on mobile. Ctrl/⌘+B toggles it.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'App shell',
      wide: true,
      render: () => (
        <div className="h-80 w-full max-w-3xl overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
          <SidebarProvider className="h-full">
            <Sidebar>
              <SidebarHeader>
                <div className="flex h-8 items-center gap-2 px-2 font-display font-semibold group-data-[collapsible=icon]/sidebar:hidden">Northwind</div>
              </SidebarHeader>
              <SidebarContent>
                <SidebarGroup>
                  <SidebarGroupLabel>Workspace</SidebarGroupLabel>
                  <SidebarGroupContent>
                    <SidebarMenu>
                      {NAV.map((item) => (
                        <SidebarMenuItem key={item.label}>
                          <SidebarMenuButton isActive={item.active} tooltip={item.label}>
                            <item.icon aria-hidden />
                            <span>{item.label}</span>
                          </SidebarMenuButton>
                          {item.badge && <SidebarMenuBadge>{item.badge}</SidebarMenuBadge>}
                        </SidebarMenuItem>
                      ))}
                    </SidebarMenu>
                  </SidebarGroupContent>
                </SidebarGroup>
              </SidebarContent>
              <SidebarSeparator />
              <SidebarFooter>
                <SidebarMenu>
                  <SidebarMenuItem>
                    <SidebarMenuButton tooltip="Settings">
                      <Settings aria-hidden />
                      <span>Settings</span>
                    </SidebarMenuButton>
                  </SidebarMenuItem>
                </SidebarMenu>
              </SidebarFooter>
            </Sidebar>
            <SidebarInset>
              <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 border-b px-3">
                <SidebarTrigger />
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">Home</span>
              </header>
              <div className="p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Your content goes here.</div>
            </SidebarInset>
          </SidebarProvider>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Table

Composable table parts for simple tabular data. Use Data Table when you need sorting or selection.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/badge @machine-ui/table`

### Badge

- `variant?`: "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Badge, Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

const INVOICES = [
  ['INV-2041', 'Paid', 'Card', '$1,250.00'],
  ['INV-2042', 'Pending', 'Bank transfer', '$480.00'],
  ['INV-2043', 'Overdue', 'Card', '$2,300.00'],
  ['INV-2044', 'Paid', 'Card', '$96.00'],
] as const;

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'table',
  name: 'Table',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'Composable table parts for simple tabular data. Use Data Table when you need sorting or selection.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Invoices',
      wide: true,
      render: () => (
        <Table className="max-w-2xl">
          <TableCaption>Invoices for October 2026.</TableCaption>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Invoice</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Method</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {INVOICES.map(([id, status, method, amount]) => (
              <TableRow key={id}>
                <TableCell className="font-medium">{id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Badge variant={status === 'Overdue' ? 'destructive' : status === 'Paid' ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}>{status}</Badge>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{method}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{amount}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
          <TableFooter>
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={3}>Total</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">$4,126.00</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          </TableFooter>
        </Table>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Tabs

Switches between views in the same context. Arrow keys move between tabs.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/tabs`

Example:

```tsx
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'tabs',
  name: 'Tabs',
  category: 'navigation',
  description: 'Switches between views in the same context. Arrow keys move between tabs.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <Tabs defaultValue="overview" className="w-full max-w-md">
          <TabsList>
            <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="activity">Activity</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="settings">Settings</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TabsContent value="overview" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            42 deploys this week, 2 rolled back.
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="activity" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Nothing new since yesterday.
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="settings" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Notifications are on for failed deploys.
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Textarea

A multi-line text field that resizes vertically. Use it for messages, notes and descriptions.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/label @machine-ui/textarea`

Example:

```tsx
import { Label, Textarea } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'textarea',
  name: 'Textarea',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'A multi-line text field that resizes vertically. Use it for messages, notes and descriptions.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-2">
          <Label htmlFor="ta-feedback">What should we improve?</Label>
          <Textarea id="ta-feedback" placeholder="The export panel could remember my last format…" />
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Invalid',
      render: () => <Textarea aria-label="Release notes" aria-invalid defaultValue="" placeholder="Release notes are required" className="max-w-sm" />,
    },
  ],
});
```

## Thinking Indicator

A short label with pulsing dots while the agent works. Announced politely; still when motion is off.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/thinking`

### ThinkingIndicator

- `label?`: string

Example:

```tsx
import { ThinkingIndicator } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'thinking-indicator',
  name: 'Thinking Indicator',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'A short label with pulsing dots while the agent works. Announced politely; still when motion is off.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Default',
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid gap-3">
          <ThinkingIndicator />
          <ThinkingIndicator label="Reading 14 files" />
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Thinking Steps

The steps an agent is working through, with done, active and upcoming states.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/thinking`

### ThinkingSteps

- `steps`: ThinkingStep[]

Example:

```tsx
import { ThinkingSteps } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'thinking-steps',
  name: 'Thinking Steps',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'The steps an agent is working through, with done, active and upcoming states.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'In progress',
      render: () => (
        <ThinkingSteps
          className="max-w-sm"
          steps={[
            { label: 'Read the Intercom thread', detail: 'ticket #8812', state: 'done' },
            { label: 'Check the changelog', detail: 'last 2 releases', state: 'done' },
            { label: 'Pull Stripe account status', state: 'active' },
            { label: 'Draft a reply', state: 'upcoming' },
          ]}
        />
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Toast

Short, temporary messages in a stack. Mount one Toaster near the root and call toast() from anywhere.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/sonner`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Button, Toaster, toast } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'toast',
  name: 'Toast',
  category: 'feedback',
  description: 'Short, temporary messages in a stack. Mount one Toaster near the root and call toast() from anywhere.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Variants',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Toaster position="bottom-right" />
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast('Theme saved', { description: 'Share the link to preview it.' })}>
            Default
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.success('Published', { description: 'Version 2.4.0 is live.' })}>
            Success
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => toast.error('Deploy failed', { description: 'Step 3 timed out.', action: { label: 'Retry', onClick: () => {} } })}
          >
            Error with action
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Toggle

A button that stays pressed, for one on/off option such as a filter or formatting.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/toggle`

### Toggle

- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null
- `variant?`: "default" | "outline" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Toggle } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { Bold, Italic, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'toggle',
  name: 'Toggle',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'A button that stays pressed, for one on/off option such as a filter or formatting.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Variants',
      render: () => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Toggle aria-label="Bold">
            <Bold aria-hidden />
          </Toggle>
          <Toggle aria-label="Italic" defaultPressed>
            <Italic aria-hidden />
          </Toggle>
          <Toggle variant="outline">
            <Star aria-hidden /> Starred only
          </Toggle>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Toggle Group

A joined row of toggles for picking one option, or several, from a small set.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/toggle-group`

### ToggleGroup

- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null
- `variant?`: "default" | "outline" | null

### ToggleGroupItem

- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null
- `variant?`: "default" | "outline" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { AlignCenter, AlignLeft, AlignRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'toggle-group',
  name: 'Toggle Group',
  category: 'forms',
  description: 'A joined row of toggles for picking one option, or several, from a small set.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Single',
      render: () => (
        <ToggleGroup type="single" defaultValue="left" variant="outline" aria-label="Text alignment">
          <ToggleGroupItem value="left" aria-label="Align left">
            <AlignLeft aria-hidden />
          </ToggleGroupItem>
          <ToggleGroupItem value="center" aria-label="Align centre">
            <AlignCenter aria-hidden />
          </ToggleGroupItem>
          <ToggleGroupItem value="right" aria-label="Align right">
            <AlignRight aria-hidden />
          </ToggleGroupItem>
        </ToggleGroup>
      ),
    },
    {
      name: 'Multiple',
      render: () => (
        <ToggleGroup type="multiple" defaultValue={['open']} aria-label="Issue filters">
          <ToggleGroupItem value="open">Open</ToggleGroupItem>
          <ToggleGroupItem value="assigned">Assigned to me</ToggleGroupItem>
          <ToggleGroupItem value="blocked">Blocked</ToggleGroupItem>
        </ToggleGroup>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Tool Call

A tool the agent called, with its status and, on demand, its input and output.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/tool-call`

### ToolCall

- `defaultOpen?`: boolean
- `input?`: string
- `name`: string
- `output?`: string
- `status`: "done" | "error" | "running"

Example:

```tsx
import { ToolCall } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'tool-call',
  name: 'Tool Call',
  category: 'ai',
  description: 'A tool the agent called, with its status and, on demand, its input and output.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'States',
      wide: true,
      render: () => (
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
          <ToolCall name="stripe.get_account" status="done" input={'{ "customer": "acme" }'} output={'{ "status": "active", "plan": "scale" }'} defaultOpen />
          <ToolCall name="intercom.search" status="running" />
          <ToolCall name="github.create_issue" status="error" output="403: token lacks repo scope" />
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Tooltip

A short label shown on hover or focus. Never put essential information only in a tooltip.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/button @machine-ui/tooltip`

### Button

- `asChild?`: boolean
- `size?`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon" | null
- `variant?`: "link" | "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | null

Example:

```tsx
import { Button, Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { Bell } from 'lucide-react';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'tooltip',
  name: 'Tooltip',
  category: 'overlays',
  description: 'A short label shown on hover or focus. Never put essential information only in a tooltip.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Icon button',
      render: () => (
        <Tooltip>
          <TooltipTrigger asChild>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Notifications">
              <Bell aria-hidden />
            </Button>
          </TooltipTrigger>
          <TooltipContent>3 unread notifications</TooltipContent>
        </Tooltip>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```

## Typography

Text styles on the theme’s fluid type scale: headings use the display face, body uses the text face.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @machine-ui/typography`

Example:

```tsx
import { Blockquote, H1, H2, H3, H4, InlineCode, Lead, List, Muted, P } from '@machine-ui/ui';
import { defineDoc } from '../types.ts';

export default defineDoc({
  slug: 'typography',
  name: 'Typography',
  category: 'data',
  description: 'Text styles on the theme’s fluid type scale: headings use the display face, body uses the text face.',
  examples: [
    {
      name: 'Article',
      wide: true,
      render: () => (
        <article className="max-w-prose">
          <H1>Make it look like yours</H1>
          <Lead className="mt-3">A theme is a handful of decisions, expanded into hundreds of consistent ones.</Lead>
          <H2 className="mt-8">Why seeds</H2>
          <P>
            Picking 19 colours by hand invites mistakes. Picking a hue, a temperature and a few personality settings does not. Run{' '}
            <InlineCode>applyTheme(seed)</InlineCode> and the rest follows.
          </P>
          <H3 className="mt-6">Light and dark together</H3>
          <P>Both modes come from one seed, so they always feel like the same product.</P>
          <H4 className="mt-6">Fluid sizes</H4>
          <P>Headings scale with the viewport; body text never drops below 1rem.</P>
          <Blockquote>Every text pair is solved for contrast before you ever see it.</Blockquote>
          <List>
            <li>Light and dark from the same seed</li>
            <li>Fluid type that never shrinks body text below 1rem</li>
            <li>Motion that turns off for people who ask for less</li>
          </List>
          <Muted>Updated 19 October 2026</Muted>
        </article>
      ),
    },
  ],
});
```
